item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli police have arrested ten settlers suspected of attacking a US photographer, a French mayor and other civilians in the West Bank, torching cars and olive trees and wounding farmers. In Gaza the World Food Programme is ending aid for half a million people because of funding shortfalls, while UNICEF reports that 340 children have been killed despite a ceasefire. Israel is also resuming entry of private-sector goods to Gaza, where five people have been reported killed. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
